<div class="card-body">
'''Blaster Rifle (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ブラスター・ライフル</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">２フォース消費して、戦士キャラクターに配備する。２フォース使って、起動する。運命数を引く。キャラクターは、（運命数＋１）＞能力値ならば命中。ビークルには、（運命数＋１）＞回避値か装甲値ならば命中する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Blaster-Rifle-Dark-SWCA-100698.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ストームトルーパー専用のブラステックＥ－11ブラスター・ライフル。銃床は折畳式で、ピストルとしてもライフルとしても使える。装弾数は100発で、軍用に限定される。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Blaster Rifle.

'''Card text:'''
Spend 2 Force to deploy on a warrior character. Use 2 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny plus 1 exceeds ability. A vehicle is hit if destiny plus 1 exceeds maneuver or armor.

'''Lore:'''
BlasTech E-11 blaster rifle for stormtroopers. Its stock folds, so it can be used as a pistol or a rifle. It holds 100 shots and is restricted to military use.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face lists separate tests for characters and vehicles.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Blaster Rifle (Dark)]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
